This map shows all health facilities that are currently licensed by the South Carolina Department of Health's (SCDPH) Bureau of Health Facilities Licensing.

Map Functionality:

Attribute Table:  

Display a tabular view of facilities in each layer. To download the records, click the Actions menu , select export all to CSV, click OK, and the records will download to your computer's downloads folder.

Search:  

You can search near a specific place by typing a city, ZIP code, a specific street address, or name of a specific facility into the search box; then click the magnifying glass or press enter/return on your keyboard.

Zoom:  

Provides interactive zoom controls in the map display. The button can be found in the upper left-hand corner.

Home:  

Click to zoom to the map's initial extent. The button can be found in the upper left-hand corner.

Legend:  

Displays a legend for the visible layers in the map. The button can be found in the upper right-hand corner.

Layers:  

Displays a list of operational layers in the app. The button can be found in the upper right-hand corner.

Share:  

Share the map via social media, email, or embed it in a website or blog. Also allows setting URL parameters for the app. Button is in the upper right-hand corner.


Contact Information

  1. Health Facility Questions: info@dph.sc.gov
  2. Map Questions: dataviz-help@dph.sc.gov
